hoyo-de-monterrey-cuba--linea-clasica.description: Hoyo de Monterrey takes its name from a plantation in San Juan y Martínez, in the Vuelta Abajo, whose gate is inscribed with the name José Gener and the year 1860. Made with Punch at the La Corona factory, the classic range includes the Double Coronas and the short Petit Robustos of 2004. Its blend is soft and fragrant, favouring finesse over power.

hoyo-de-monterrey-cuba--linea-epicure.description: The Epicure line brings together the Epicure No. 1, No. 2 and Especial in a presentation of their own; the Especial first appeared as an Edición Limitada in 2004 and joined the regular range in 2008. Rolled by hand from Vuelta Abajo leaf, it opens with cedar, almond and vanilla, then turns to coffee, cocoa and baking spice on a creamy smoke.

thirds.notes: Creamy cedar and toasted almond with vanilla, a honeyed sweetness and gentle spice.
The sweetness gives way to cocoa powder and mild roast coffee, with nuttiness and baking spice.
Dark cocoa and earth lead, with returning cedar and spice and a light dried-fruit sweetness.

hoyo-de-monterrey-cuba--serie-le-hoyo.description: Serie Le Hoyo gathers slim and mid-gauge Hoyo de Monterrey sizes, later joined by the 54-ring Le Hoyo de San Juan in 2014 and the thicker Le Hoyo de Río Seco in 2018. Made by hand from Vuelta Abajo tobacco, the San Juan smokes smooth and light to medium in body, with cream, soft cinnamon, wood and a little chocolate.

sources.title: FOH Cigars forum – Deep dive: Le Hoyo de San Juan

hoyo-de-monterrey-cuba--reserva-en-gran-.description: Hoyo de Monterrey's harvest-dated releases: the Epicure No. 2 Reserva Cosecha 2012, introduced in 2016 in a run of 5,000 boxes, and the Double Coronas Gran Reserva Cosecha 2013, the first Gran Reserva in that size. The Reserva begins with honey, brown sugar and toasted nuts, then moves through cedar and cinnamon to dark chocolate and espresso.

thirds.notes: Honey, brown sugar and toasted nuts over a smooth, creamy base.
The sweetness softens as cedar and a touch of cinnamon come forward on a velvety draw.
Richer and bolder, with dark chocolate, espresso and mild pepper, ending creamy and earthy.

sources.title: Online Cigars – Hoyo de Monterrey Epicure No. 2 Reserva Cosecha 2012 review

hoyo-de-monterrey-cuba--edicion-limitada.description: Hoyo de Monterrey's Ediciones Limitadas belong to the Habanos series begun in 2000: sizes absent from the regular range, rolled from leaf aged at least two years, with a black and gold seal and an extra band naming the year. The Epicure Especial began this way in 2004 before entering the permanent range in 2008.
